your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: I own no properties yet to trade. Ending turn is the best action here as it's the beginning of the game.
Still early game, I have no properties to trade and there's no reason to buy single properties from others for pure cash at a premium right now. Ending turn.
Still early in the game and I have just landed on GO. I don't hold any properties yet, so no need to propose any trades right now. I will save my $1900 to buy whatever I land on next.
Boardwalk is a premium property and there is only Park Place left to complete the set. I have $1900, which is plenty of cash to buy it for $400. Not letting this go to auction.
I bought Boardwalk and have plenty of cash left. I don't need to mortgage it. There are no sensible trades right now since I just got my first property. Ending turn.
Connecticut Avenue is $120. Claude already has Vermont, so by me buying Connecticut, it blocks him from easily completing the Light Blue set and gives me a good trading chip for later. Purchasing.
I just bought Connecticut Avenue. I have no urgent trades to make since I just hold Connecticut and Boardwalk. I'll end my turn.
